name: tool-scope
title: Tool scope
description: Scope research tools with the user before building them: automatically in a tool repository (TOOL.toml) and for every folder under a study's tools/, on request elsewhere. The claim first, then features, then an evidence basis and a recorded decision for every scientific feature.
notes: A tool repository is scoped automatically, with its record at SCOPE.toml in the root; in a study, every folder under tools/ is, with its record at tools/<name>/SCOPE.toml (template: .agents/templates/SCOPE.toml). .agents/tools/scope-status shows what is open, including tools with no record yet.
